memory_view.title: Memory
memory_view.load_error_title: The memory could not be loaded
memory_view.load_error_body: The vault did not answer. Check that the wiki is switched on in Settings.
memory_view.area_entities_hint: People, tools, places and everything else {name} keeps facts about.
memory_view.area_entities_empty: When {name} learns about a person or a thing, its page appears here.
memory_view.area_projects_hint: What you are working on: goals, status, open threads.
memory_view.area_projects_empty: Projects {name} hears about get a page here.
memory_view.area_concepts_hint: Ideas, definitions and methods worth keeping.
memory_view.area_concepts_empty: No concepts yet. Create one for an idea you want {name} to remember.
memory_view.area_journal_empty: Session summaries appear here once they are written.
memory_view.area_system_hint: How the memory works, its schema and the log of every change.
memory_view.area_agents_hint: Each agent keeps two notebooks: what it learned about its work, and what it knows about you.
memory_view.home_lead: Linked Markdown pages in your Obsidian vault. They grow from conversations and from the agents' own notes, and you can read, edit and connect them here.
memory_view.vault_empty_body: Pages appear here as {name} learns about people, projects and your preferences. You can also write the first one yourself.
memory_view.links_title: {inbound} pages link here, this page links to {outbound}
memory_view.agent_nothing_yet: Has not written anything down yet.
memory_view.agents_empty_body: When an agent remembers something, its notebook appears here.
memory_view.tidy_body: These notebooks belong to deleted or unknown agents and contain nothing. They move to the vault's _archive folder; nothing is deleted.
memory_view.tidy_nothing: There is nothing to tidy up.
memory_view.editor_hint: [[ links a page · Ctrl S saves · Esc cancels
memory_view.rename_description: Every link to this page is updated to the new name.
memory_view.archive_body: The page moves to the vault's _archive folder and leaves the memory. You can restore it from there in Obsidian.
memory_view.new_description: Start a page for a person, a project or an idea. You can link it from other pages with [[its name]].
memory_view.page_missing_body: It was renamed, archived or removed in the vault.
memory_view.page_empty_title: This page has no content yet
memory_view.page_empty_body: It exists in the vault but nothing has been written to it.
memory_view.page_empty_editable: Write what should be remembered here, and link related pages with [[their name]].
memory_view.notebook_empty_body: {agent} has not written to this notebook. Entries appear here as soon as it remembers something.
memory_view.link_missing: This page does not exist yet. Click to create it.
memory_view.no_connections: This page is not connected to any other page yet.
memory_view.mentioned_in_hint: Pages that name this one without linking it.
memory_view.related_hint: Share a connection with this page.
memory_view.map_error: The map could not be loaded.
memory_view.map_empty_body: The map shows pages with content and how they link. It fills as the memory grows.
memory_view.health_ok: Writes land and the search index is up to date.
memory_view.health_writer_off: The memory writer did not start.
memory_view.health_index_stale: The search index has {indexed} of {pages} pages. Rebuild it to find everything.
memory_view.health_backlog: {count} learned facts are waiting to be written.
memory_view.health_reindex_failed: The search index could not be rebuilt.
memory_view.renamed_unrewritten: {count} agent notebooks still link the old name; their agents keep them.
